svg.title: Three-dimensional Teensy Octo board and output test flow
svg.desc: A large isometric Teensy package and Octo adapter scene connects eight parallel pixel lanes to schematic dual RJ45 connectors. Above, boot, stream and recovery states orbit the hardware; side controls show individual/all-port RGB tests. Physical connector orientation remains an acceptance item.

g.text: Light from a named board profile.
Boot armed. Send a test pattern through the Octo adapter. Identify and verify each physical lane.
LEVEL SHIFT / TWO LED RJ45 CONNECTORS
Identify + label each lane → test ports individually → test all active ports in parallel.
Web preview shows software intent, not LED feedback. Confirm the adapter revision and RJ45 orientation on the hardware.
